measurement_scope: ROI denotes region of interest. Counts of 5930 and 535 refer to sample observations rather than unique regions. The formal cloud evaluation comprises 300 full scenes.

title: Project-level access chronology
measurement_scope: Access dates establish the sequence of configuration development and evaluation. Flood public-pool results remain descriptive because the pool was accessed before configuration freezing.

title: Three-node hardware snapshot
measurement_scope: Snapshot date: 28 August 2026. Available RAM is time-dependent and is not a compile budget.

measurement_scope: Sizes are independently rounded. ONNX + MXR rounded subtotals need not reproduce the rounded bundle total exactly. Ordered artifact hashes can be requested from the corresponding author under the conditions in Section S11; model and cache payloads are not included.

measurement_scope: P90 denotes the 90th percentile across the retained scenes. L_i is MAE; s_i is relative-l2 error. Q/DQ ancestry is a source-graph property, not by itself proof of an integer kernel.

measurement_scope: All candidates use the training-derived configuration set. U42-U46 identify the random-seed controls. The public-pool flood results are reported separately in Table S14.

measurement_scope: Graph labels identify distinct candidate roles. Auxiliary and attempted graphs are not accepted deployments.

measurement_scope: Corresponds to manuscript Table 5. Mixed-precision compilation time is a lower bound because reused-session durations are missing.

measurement_scope: The 13S mixed-precision measurement in this table covers selected merges. Complete-graph accounting is reported in Table S11. Unavailable and uninstrumented measurements remain explicitly identified.

measurement_scope: I8II and HBH are retained kernel-category labels. Unreported counts are not treated as zero. These measurements establish path realization under their trace scopes.

measurement_scope: Corresponds to manuscript Table 3. All scores describe the 90-image public pool, which was accessed during configuration development.

measurement_scope: Difference is candidate minus its paired reference for the stated scene-level metric. The retained mean paired mIoU differences are not differences of pooled mIoU values. No independent-confirmation interpretation is made.

measurement_scope: Removal of runtime index 0 is post hoc and does not create an independent test set.

title: Formal cloud segmentation results
measurement_scope: Corresponds to manuscript Table 7. All variants use the 14-session cloud topology. The formal evaluation contains 300 full scenes and 24,300 tile calls per variant.

title: Complete formal cloud paired scene-bootstrap results
measurement_scope: Difference is candidate minus reference; bounds are one-sided 95% lower bounds. PASS/FAIL is retained per criterion. The mixed candidate is rejected because of agreement.

measurement_scope: Prev. means class prevalence. The any-cloud aggregation combines the three non-clear classes. Rounded display metrics do not replace the retained full-precision confusion matrices.

title: Exploratory practical-margin sensitivity
measurement_scope: Threshold columns are hypothetical tolerated decreases. Registered acceptance decisions are unchanged.

measurement_scope: Corresponds to manuscript Table 8. The mixed candidate fails the task-agreement requirement despite its measured latency.

measurement_scope: Median of process medians differs from the pooled-call median in the preceding table. Confidence intervals use the retained five fresh-process medians.

measurement_scope: These configuration-validation protocols characterize graph-reduction candidates and are separate from the five-process controlled benchmark.

measurement_scope: Corresponds to manuscript Table 6. The FP32 sustained-operation result uses the isolated Node 2 experiment. The partly shared Node 3 experiment is excluded from this comparison.
